name: Truncated-Cube Contraction Obstructions
definition: $\mathcal T_d=\{A\subseteq[d]:|A|\le d-2\}$, the subfamily of the $d$-cube obtained by deleting the top vertex and all $d$ of its neighbors.
parameters: $d\ge3$. It has $2^d-d-1$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: Equivalently, retain exactly the Boolean layers of ranks at most $d-2$.
recognition: The displayed set-family representation certifies the family. Every coordinate contraction is $Q_{d-1}$ with its top vertex deleted.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. The member $\mathcal T_3$ is the three-leaf star $K_{1,3}$, and $\mathcal T_4$ has eleven vertices.
